'''Vormfruit''' was a type of [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] found and [[Farm/Legends|farmed]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Dantooine" /> It was known to be sweet and a component for dishes such as [[braised scyk belly]]<ref name="Belly" /> and [[exotic medley delight]].<ref name="Delight" /> The fruit was also exported to other worlds such as [[Voss]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Joint Efforts|Voss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vormfruit was one of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] that players had to find on Dantooine to receive the "Dantoonian Culinarian" achievement.<ref name="Dantooine" />
